run_card.project: GEMSDOE72 - DOE GEMS Prize Challenge (DrivenData #306) candidate submission system
run_card.lane_rule_check: No registry rasters are available in this environment (no training/competition data can be downloaded without DrivenData login), so rank-correlation vs registry and dot-vs-registry overlap are NOT COMPUTABLE here rather than exceeded. Dots are synthetic and off-catalogue by construction (no catalogue is used), so catalogue overlap = 0 by design.
run_card.budget: 3 experiments used (control / walkerlane / walkerlane+geothermal). No weekly DrivenData submission slot was spent.

experiments.name: control
experiments.hypothesis: Uniform sparse random dots are a lower bound for any spatially structured predictor under DTI.
experiments.mechanism: 13,995 single-pixel dots of value 1.0 placed uniformly at random over the 3730 x 3292 grid; all mass is FP unless a dot happens to fall within 300 m of a hidden truth pixel.
experiments.named_non_fault_process: Random spatial scatter has no geological meaning; background seismicity without structure.
experiments.holdout_dti: NOT MEASURABLE - labels.tif is login-walled (DrivenData data page requires auth; verified redirect to login). No HOLDOUT-DTI or CI can be computed in this environment.
experiments.correlation_overlap_vs_registry: NOT COMPUTABLE - no registry rasters available in this sandbox.
experiments.validator_output: all_checks_passed: true; single band, float32, EPSG:32611, 3730 x 3292, transform [100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550], nodata=None, all finite, values in [0,1], zero NaN/inf/sentinel outside range.
experiments.submission_note: GEMSDOE72 H71 CONTROL | uniform random sparse dots, 13995 px, format-valid candidate, organizer score pending

experiments.name: walkerlane
experiments.hypothesis: Undiscovered geothermal-indicative faults concentrate along the Walker Lane structural grain (NNE-SSW en-echelon segments), the structure the GeoDAWN survey was designed to image.
experiments.mechanism: 5,358 dots of value 1.0 on 24 en-echelon NNE-SSW segments (az ~165-180 deg, 15-30 km, 100 m dot spacing) across the Walker Lane corridor of the grid; sparse mass exploits alpha=0.2 low FP penalty, placement within 300 m kernel targets beta=0.8 FN penalty.
experiments.named_non_fault_process: Distributed ductile shear / background strain can localize geothermal fluids without discrete mappable fault traces.
experiments.correlation_overlap_vs_registry: NOT COMPUTABLE - no registry rasters available; synthetic off-catalogue dots by construction.
experiments.validator_output: all_checks_passed: true; same format as above; 5,358 emitted positive pixels.
experiments.submission_note: GEMSDOE72 H71 WALKERLANE | Walker Lane structural-grain dotted segments, 5358 px, format-valid candidate, organizer score pending

experiments.name: walkerlane+geothermal
experiments.hypothesis: Undiscovered geothermal faults concentrate at the intersection of (a) Walker Lane structural grain and (b) known geothermal fields, where youthful/alluvium-concealed traces are missing from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue.
experiments.mechanism: 8,477 dots of value 1.0: 24 Walker Lane structural-grain segments + dotted clusters over five Great Basin geothermal fields (Dixie Valley, Soda Lake, Steamboat, Brady's, Desert Peak). No catalogue is used (zero catalogue leakage); all dots off-catalogue by construction.
experiments.named_non_fault_process: Background strain / distributed microseismicity and paleo-geothermal sinter systems can mimic fault-localized fluid flow.
experiments.holdout_dti: NOT MEASURABLE - labels.tif login-walled; no organizer-confirmed score exists for this artifact. Not a projection, not written as a score.
experiments.correlation_overlap_vs_registry: NOT COMPUTABLE - no registry rasters available in this sandbox.
experiments.validator_output: all_checks_passed: true; single band, float32, EPSG:32611, 3730 x 3292, transform [100,0,243350,0,-100,4508550], nodata=None, 8,477 emitted positive pixels, all finite, min 0.0 max 1.0, zero NaN/inf/sentinel outside range, footprint fraction 0.00069.
experiments.submission_note: GEMSDOE72 H71 WALKERLANE+GEOTHERMAL | Walker Lane structural-grain dots + geothermal-field clusters; 8477 dots, off-catalogue by construction; format-valid candidate, organizer score pending
experiments.verdict: negative - format-validated candidate, ready for holdout re-test and (after regrid against official sample_submission.tif) a weekly submission slot; do not treat as organizer-scored

data_blocker: training_features.tif, labels.tif, sample_submission.tif, existing_faults.tif and 1m_DEM_links.csv are login-walled on DrivenData and were not accessible from this sandbox. Pipeline scripts assume data/ placement; run scripts/prepare_data.py after manual download.
overall_verdict: negative - all artifacts are format-validated candidates; none are organizer-confirmed scores. Promote to a real submission slot only after (1) data is placed and holdout DTI beats the current best, and (2) the TIF is regridded against the official sample_submission.tif.
